dedupe_keys.name: brittany pig feed manure and treated waste elemental composition

description: This dataset follows macro and trace elements through pig feed, manure and waste-treatment products. INRAE compares storage alone with in-building separation, anaerobic digestion of solids and digestate drying. Three public tab-separated tables describe effluent samples, composition measurements and feed composition, including copper and zinc. The article identifies two farms and a digestion unit in Brittany, France, sampled four times over two months in 2021. Coverage is those treatment chains, not a national agricultural inventory. Recherche Data Gouv distributes all three files without restrictions under the Etalab Open Licence 2.0, so access is free. Limited campaigns and total-compound measurements constrain extrapolation to long-term soil accumulation or trace-element bioavailability. Modellers could parameterise material balances and manure-treatment simulations. platform-brightway-lca is a related assessment environment, but additional throughput and emissions information would be needed for full life-cycle modelling. The review read public metadata and file inventories without downloading measured values.
